skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Attire worn by Texas following her return to Siracusa.
Exceptionally exquisite tailoring, exactingly custom-made to old Siracusan famiglie standards.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
She leaves Siracusa once again, not to flee the past, but to change the future.
This outfit neither binds her nor stands for her. She is merely Texas.

skins.name: Il Segreto Della Notte
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Il Segreto Della Notte. A form-fitting combination of tailored clothes and exquisite accessories, displaying one's status without drawing too much attention. Comes with a VIP Carnevale invitation and too many balloons.
skins.usage: One of Texas the Omertosa's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Yet another Carnevale, and all Texas wants is to relax, but her annoying boss has hidden himself in every balloon, telling her to get back to work. Nothing she can do except step on each and every one of them.

skins.name: Wingbreaker
skins.content: Iteration Provident Series/Wingbreaker. Texas the Omertosa's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The hunter shot down the great demon Vermithrax, but was betrayed by the Lone Wolf Emperor and banished to the barrens.
skins.usage: One of Texas the Omertosa's iteration points.
skins.quote: 'But Wingbreaker, did you know that behind the seven layers of golden gates remain only shepherds of demons, and nothing more of your old friends?'
